markdown.markdown:
::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false}
**All participants**

-   [ ] Keep an eye out for course materials as they are released

**Online participants**

-   [ ] Considering joining or starting an online hub, to attend together
-   [ ] Check your internet connection and audio setup\
-   [ ] Test your access to the meeting platform\
-   [ ] Plan a quiet workspace where possible

**In-person participants**

-   [ ] Bring your laptop (required for hands-on sessions)\
-   [ ] Bring a notebook or pen for quick notes\
-   [ ] Pre-download course materials in case Wi-Fi is limited\

**If you are attending Days 1–2**

-   [ ] Prepare for the [lightning round](#lightning)
-   [ ] Work with your jurisdiction to create a [poster](#poster)

**If you are attending Days 3–5**

-   [ ] Install required software *(details to be provided)*\
-   [ ] Ensure your laptop is fully updated\
-   [ ] Confirm you can install and run R / required tools
:::


Prepare a short introduction (\~2 minutes):

-   your name\
-   your organisation\
-   one current challenge\
-   one thing you hope to learn

## Poster session {#poster}

As a jurisdiction, bring a digital poster representing your work, team, or context. This is intentionally flexible! Ideas include:

-   a flagship stock assessment\
-   a challenging case study\
-   your team and region ("getting to know us")\
-   a methodological innovation\
-   a collaboration success story
